title: Unicon grading verdict
description: What the harness posts back through the callback at the end of a run. The forge repo checks it against this schema and keeps it on the gradings row; nothing else stores it. One shape for every task: an outcome from a fixed list, metrics as named numbers, one row per test with its own outcome, time, memory and metrics, a summary for the contestant, resource usage and the log pointer. There is no separate score. Whatever number a task is ranked on is a metric the leaderboard names, so a scorer that emits points and one that emits accuracy are the same shape. The verdict repeats the forge identity of both the submission and the task so it can be matched back after a loss of the Unicon database.

then.description: Nobody graded: the harness could not run the plan, a primitive broke, or a step could not start. Nothing about the submission is known, so there are no rows and no metrics, and the summary says what went wrong for staff to read.

schema_version.description: The verdict shape this file is written against.

grading_id.description: The gradings row this verdict belongs to, copied from the envelope.

stage.description: Grading stage, copied from the envelope.

attempt.description: Attempt number, copied from the envelope.

outcome.description: The result of the whole run, from the fixed list every task shares. accepted: every test passed. partial: some did, and the metrics say how much. wrong_answer, time_limit, memory_limit, output_limit, runtime_error: the first failing kind, decided by the workflow's own rule. compile_error: the submission did not build, which is a normal result. system_error: the harness could not grade at all, and staff should look; never a grade.

metrics.description: Named numbers the workflow measured over the whole run, for example points, accuracy or max_time_ms. A leaderboard ranks on one of these by name. Numbers only, so a board can sort them.

tests.description: One row per test the plan ran, in plan order, each with its own outcome, time, memory and metrics. Empty when the workflow has no per-test structure, for example a single-metric evaluation.

summary.description: A few lines for the contestant, as the task's visibility rules allow them to be shown. For a system error, what went wrong, for staff.

resources.description: What the whole run used, over every step.

wall_ms.description: Wall clock from accepting the envelope to finishing the last step.

cpu_ms.description: CPU time over every step container, or null when the machine could not measure it.

peak_memory_kb.description: The largest peak memory any one step container reached, or null when not measured.

log.description: Where the run log went: the object URL the log was written to, without the presigned query, so the forge repo can find it in unicon-results. Null when the log could not be written.

started_at.description: When the harness accepted the envelope.

finished_at.description: When the harness finished the last step.

test.description: One row of the per-test table.

id.description: The test's name as the task spells it.

outcome.description: This test's result, from the same list as the run's. skipped: not run, because an earlier test or step made it pointless.

time_ms.description: Wall clock for this test, or null when the step was not measured. Explicitly null rather than absent, so an absent measurement is a statement and not an oversight.

memory_kb.description: Peak memory for this test, or null when the step was not measured.

metrics.description: Named numbers for this test alone, for example its points.

message.description: The checker's note, shown next to the row when the stage allows it.

submission.description: The forge identity of what was graded, copied from the envelope.

org.description: The org that owns the submission repo.

repo.description: The contestant's submission repo for one task, <contest>.<task>.<owner>.sub.

tag.description: The protected tag that is the submission, submission/<n>.

commit.description: Full commit sha the tag points at.

task.description: The forge identity of the task this verdict was graded against, copied from the envelope. Without it the publication below names nothing.

org.description: The org that owns the task, the same org the submission is in.

publication.description: Which publication produced this verdict, copied from the envelope. Two verdicts on the same submission under different publications were graded against different tests.

tag.description: The protected tag on the task repo, published/<n>.

commit.description: Full commit sha the tag pointed at.
